cases: SELECT a.id,b.id FROM stratigraphic_assertions a JOIN stratigraphic_assertions b ON a.source_context_id=b.target_context_id AND a.target_context_id=b.source_context_id WHERE a.id<b.id
SELECT a.author,b.author FROM interpretations a JOIN interpretations b ON a.context_id=b.context_id AND a.id<b.id WHERE a.earliest<=b.latest AND b.earliest<=a.latest
SELECT asset_id,COUNT(DISTINCT context_id) FROM asset_subjects GROUP BY asset_id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT context_id)>1
SELECT id FROM assets WHERE availability='external'

SELECT f.nisp,f.mni,p.sherd_count,p.estimated_vessels FROM fauna_results f JOIN analyses a ON a.id=f.analysis_id JOIN samples s ON s.id=a.sample_id JOIN find_lots l ON l.context_id=s.context_id JOIN objects o ON o.lot_id=l.id JOIN pottery_results p ON p.object_id=o.id
SELECT o.id,c.native_locus FROM objects o JOIN find_lots l ON l.id=o.lot_id JOIN contexts c ON c.id=l.context_id

SELECT i.author,p.form,f.taxon FROM interpretations i JOIN interpretation_evidence e ON e.interpretation_id=i.id LEFT JOIN pottery_results p ON p.id=e.pottery_result_id LEFT JOIN fauna_results f ON f.id=e.fauna_result_id ORDER BY i.id
SELECT s.parent_id,r.preparation FROM samples s JOIN analyses a ON a.sample_id=s.parent_id JOIN soil_results r ON r.analysis_id=a.id WHERE s.parent_id IS NOT NULL
